title: {Syn} Skip Lists Use Coin Flips for Ordered Search
content:
A skip list maintains multiple linked-list layers so searches can skip across long stretches, then drop down for detail. Random promotion decides which elements appear in higher layers.

Expected search, insert, and delete time is logarithmic, giving a probabilistic alternative to balanced trees.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
